title: A joke must remember the greeting it comments on
authorship_scope: The evidenced correction, comment or reported decision only.

context.value: The dealer welcomed Nik; Kit immediately joked that he could have said hello.

desired_experience.value: A perceptive, entertaining DM whose reactions belong to the exchange.

observation.value: The player singled out the aside as unaware and a non sequitur.

diagnosis.value: It contradicted the greeting just spoken.

decision.value: Reject the aside and document the failed test.

underlying_principle.value: Coherence with the current exchange inhibits the urge to add a quip.

anti_pattern.value: Delivering a joke whose premise the immediately preceding dialogue disproves.

conditions_limits.value: Banter remains welcome when its premise is true; this is not a ban on humor.

title: Keep the playable consequence of a marked deck
authorship_scope: The evidenced correction, comment or reported decision only.

context.value: A source-backed marked deck and cheating dealer were reduced to an invented high-card game.

desired_experience.value: A card activity in which cheating and noticing it can matter during play.

observation.value: The player rejected high card and negligible stakes, naming several richer D&D games.

diagnosis.value: The simplification removed the meaningful complexity of cheating and detecting it.

decision.value: Require a game and opportunity to check during gambling; document the failure.

underlying_principle.value: Add mechanical depth when it makes an established feature actionable.

anti_pattern.value: A nominal activity that erases the interaction the scene promises.

conditions_limits.value: Depth is conditional on choosing to play; K03 shows that the activity must also be escapable.

evidence.locator: Exact exchange on 'What game is it?'; diagnosis items 2–4

limits: The transcript says 'a matching coin'; one gold is the player's characterization, not a fixed denomination in the transcript.

title: Let an optional activity recede
authorship_scope: The evidenced correction, comment or reported decision only.

context.value: The repaired card game required another ante-card choice while the player wanted the rest of the room.

desired_experience.value: Sustained NPC interests and story beyond compulsory card choices.

observation.value: The player asked to move on; the scene kept returning to the minigame.

diagnosis.value: The feedback says card games must remain optional and the scene should continue through interests and story.

decision.value: Request another avenue through the encounter instead of more card procedure.

underlying_principle.value: Preserve depth inside a chosen activity while allowing attention to leave it.

anti_pattern.value: Requiring continued participation because a subsystem has been prepared.

conditions_limits.value: The player still owns unresolved choices; backgrounding must not silently choose their ante or fabricate a result.

limits: n13 is a recorded feedback paraphrase, not verbatim user speech.

title: A working procedure is insufficient if the room has no perceptible point
authorship_scope: The evidenced correction, comment or reported decision only.

context.value: A hand was dealt and cheating discovered, but the player still could not see why the room mattered.

desired_experience.value: Readable reasons to engage with the occupants or explore other possibilities.

observation.value: The player ended the test: 'The room has a point. The point was not evident.'

diagnosis.value: The room's point was not evident in the delivered play.

decision.value: End the test and publish the failure.

underlying_principle.value: Judge an encounter by the opportunities the player can perceive, not merely correct internal procedures.

anti_pattern.value: Treating described scenery, a passed check or successful state persistence as proof of an engaging encounter.

conditions_limits.value: The criticism does not identify one required secret, route or solution; making significance perceptible need not reveal hidden facts.

limits: The room-function interpretation is the report author's analysis, not an exact expansion of Brendon's sentence.

title: A bonus needs the condition that grants it
authorship_scope: The evidenced correction, comment or reported decision only.

context.value: Kit granted Sentinel Shield advantage to a character seated at cards without establishing that it was held.

desired_experience.value: Account for physical implications and state the reason for advantage or disadvantage.

observation.value: The player called the holding assumption generous or naive.

diagnosis.value: Ownership and a sheet bonus do not establish the required held state.

decision.value: Consider the situation; ask only if necessary; use an established bonus source.

underlying_principle.value: Adjudicate from the character's situated condition instead of an unconditional inventory flag.

anti_pattern.value: Apply a conditional benefit merely because an item is owned.

conditions_limits.value: The recorded correction says to ask only if necessary.

limits: Skippy's newer situation defaults are an implementation, not additional historical Brendon evidence.
Do not convert this into an ask-before-every-roll policy.

title: Make protected magical limits discoverable
authorship_scope: The evidenced correction, comment or reported decision only.

context.value: A draft proposed replacing curses with 'Damned' to protect a plot mechanism.

desired_experience.value: Players can identify which arcane effects cannot be circumvented.

observation.value: Brendon's comment points to Detect Magic reporting a spell school.

diagnosis.value: A special boundary needs an identifiable in-world category.

decision.value: Design discoverable Arcanian spell schools with variations on existing spells.

underlying_principle.value: A campaign can preserve specific constraints while supplying evidence players can use to recognize them.

anti_pattern.value: Either assume every intended bypass must work, or hide a special prohibition until a player tries it.

conditions_limits.value: This is an early campaign-specific design choice. It challenges an absolute anti-preparation-protection rule, but does not establish when present-day Brendon would preserve a boundary.

limits: Brendon authored the comment; the anchored 'Damned' sentence's author is unknown.
